about.lead: Payment systems at i2c. Microservices for the Careem Super App. Secure email at Zertificon.
about.body: Currently a Master's student in Artificial Intelligence, and a working student at Zertificon in Berlin.
about.imageAlt: Black and white portrait of Hassan Chattha in a black T-shirt

experience.summary: Operates and monitors the secure mail pipeline (TLS, S/MIME and PGP gateways), renews X.509 certificates and rotates keys.
highlights: Operate and monitor the secure mail pipeline, keeping the TLS, S/MIME and PGP gateways running smoothly.
Renew expiring X.509 certificates, rotate keys and roll out new cipher-suite settings to staging and production.
Build minimal test cases for product teams and validate them in a sandbox before rollout.

experience.summary: Built a REST microservice for the Careem Super App with vector Postgres and JWT-based OAuth, deployed with GitHub Actions and Docker on AWS.
highlights: Developed a scalable REST microservice for the Careem Super App, using vector Postgres for efficient data management and JWT-based OAuth for secure authentication.
Kept the service running reliably with Grafana for monitoring, Kibana for logging and Jaeger for request tracing with OpenTelemetry.
Managed CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, deploying the dockerised service on AWS.
Refined prompts to improve the accuracy of results from large language models such as GPT.

experience.summary: Moved payment services to an event-driven microservices architecture with Spring Boot and Kafka, and worked with the ISO 8583 standard.
highlights: Led the shift to an event-driven microservices architecture with Spring Boot and Maven, improving scalability and reducing maintenance overhead.
Integrated Kafka for transaction handling, increasing throughput and reducing latency.
Introduced rigorous reliability and performance testing, automated with Bash scripts.
Streamlined deployment with Docker, reducing deployment time and server resource use, which enabled faster delivery.
Automated testing with UFT scripts, reducing testing time and increasing test coverage of critical functions.
Worked with the ISO 8583 standard, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and protecting sensitive data.

experience.summary: Backend development with Java and JavaFX, working closely with the QA team.
highlights: Developed backend features in Java and JavaFX, improving performance through better code structure and resource management.
Reduced processing time for critical operations with suitable algorithms and data structures.
Worked closely with the SQA team, speeding up bug fixes and reducing post-release defects.
